cardDirectKeyConfigDesc: Configure Douyin Pay merchant-level keys and certificates
cardCapabilityBindingDesc: Decide which Douyin app each payment capability uses to initiate payment
cardTransferSceneDesc: View Douyin transfer scenes and report field descriptions
transferSceneReadonlyTip: Douyin transfer scenes are fixed platform enums (1001-1007) and need no pre-configuration; choose a scene and fill in report info when initiating a transfer
transferSceneUserPerceptionTip: The message payee sees in Douyin; defaults to the first option when not provided
transferSceneReportFieldsTip: Report fields use fixed Douyin protocol Chinese types; contents are filled in when initiating a transfer
cardTransferAppConfigDesc: Bind the Douyin app that initiates transfers (Web App only)
transferAppTip: Transfers are made through this app; the payee OpenId is obtained via Web App H5 authorization. Only Web Apps can be bound.
transferAppNotConfigured: No transfer initiator app bound yet. Configure one before initiating a Douyin transfer.
